---
title: "3_enrich_out_conn"
format: html
---
Enrich connectivity dataframe using add_ffr_attr.R function, to pull attributes from free-flowing river data as well as join with our protected area data.

```{r}
#| label: setup

# Load libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidygraph)
library(leaflet)
library(sfnetworks)
library(igraph)

# Load out from 1_net_with_dams_from_network.qmd
out_path <- "/capstone/netzerohydro/data/processed_data/net_with_dams_GIS_v2.rds"
out <- readRDS(out_path)

# Load out_conn from 2_run_connectivity_from_network.qmd
out_conn_path <- "/capstone/netzerohydro/data/processed_data/reach_df_threshold_test.rds"
out_conn <- readRDS(out_conn_path)

# Source function
source("R/add_ffr_attr.R")
```

Run add_ffr_attr function.

```{r}
#| label: run-function

out_enriched <- add_ffr_attr(
  net_with_dams = out$net_with_dams,
  reach_df = out_conn$reach_df,
  edge_attr_cols = c("csi", "bas_name", "main_riv", "hyriv_id")
)
```
